input.content: Pattern: input-normalization change silently swaps a resilient wrapper for its single-attempt primitive (e.g. read_resilient(key) -> read_once(key.strip())), dropping a documented retry contract. A new test then asserts the regressed behavior (TransientRead raised after one attempt), so the suite stays green. Review check: when a diff touches the call into a retry/resilience wrapper, confirm the wrapper is still the callee, and compare new test expectations against the component README contract instead of trusting green tests. Fix: apply the normalization inside the wrapped call (read_resilient(key.strip())), and test retry-then-success, exhaustion attempt count, and permanent-error first-attempt propagation.
